summary: VM becomes unstable and fails to start after reboot
description: The customer reported that the VM repeatedly failed to start and sometimes became unresponsive after reboot. First-CS reviewed the symptoms, guided the customer through a VM rebuild, and the issue was resolved without escalation.

comments.body: Reporter said the VM did not start after reboot and the console showed intermittent boot failures.
First-CS checked the VM status, confirmed that a rebuild was appropriate, and shared the rebuild procedure with the customer.
Customer completed the rebuild and confirmed that the VM started normally and the issue was resolved.
